nodes.label: favicon.svg (default Vite lightning-bolt logo)
nodes.description: 48x46 SVG of a purple (#863bff) stylized lightning bolt whose interior is masked with blurred ellipses in lavender (#ede6ff), deep violet (#7e14ff) and cyan (#47bfff) to give a glowing gradient, using display-p3 colors. This is the stock Vite logo, not a Boxy brand mark.
nodes.rationale: Leftover from the Vite project scaffold. index.html links /favicon-64.png as the actual favicon and vite-plugin-pwa includeAssets lists favicon-64.png and apple-touch-icon.png, so this SVG is not the Boxy brand icon; it is only shipped because the Workbox globPatterns precache every *.svg in dist (confirmed in dist/sw.js).

nodes.label: Vite scaffold default logo (unused brand placeholder)
nodes.rationale: Template asset created by create-vite; superseded by the Boxy PNG icons (favicon-64.png, icon-*.png) but never removed, so it still gets precached by the PWA service worker.
